posts.name: Julia
posts.cooked:
I have stuff!!!

My swap item from BlueHairedMeerkat arrived! He sent me a Sentinels themed hack of the 2 player game Pocket Battles, which is a pocket-sized skirmish game. In this version, I got a hero deck (including most of the heroes we know so far, plus some of Unity's bots!) and a villain deck (consisting of Dawn, Blade and Omnitron + a shedload of Citizens and minions).

It's full colour and I can really tell that BlueHairedMeerkat put a hell of a lot of time into this. The cards alone with their skill icons and the rulebook using the card pic in the set up and stuff-WOW!

Obviosuly, nobody's been around to play all day, so all I could do so far was to read the rules, muck around with teambuilding and trying to beat myself up, but I took some pictures to show what it looks like from the heroes side of things. 

Anyway, thanks a ton to BlueHairedMeerkat for this really cool game. It's so cool, I'll put some shades on it and take it on holiday!

posts.name: Julia
posts.cooked:
My mum also has stuff!

Ghost's parcel arrived here this morning all the way from Canada. He made the entire Freedom Five in Perler Beads- both their heads and their icons. Seriously, check them out! 

My mum was absoutely delighted, and especially loved Absolute Zero because of that cool light reflex and Bunker, because he's not only awesome but also her favourite hero. She's still debating whether to make them into magnets or whether to frame them or something. Also in the parcel was a pile of canadian change that my mum requested as crafting supplies, and now she has plenty of animal and ship coins to turn into stuff- seriously though, how cool are canadian coins (especially when compared to our super lame euros)?

Anyway, my mum was really happy about her parcel, and now thinks that maybe Ghost got the short end of the stick in this swap because, as she said, 'Making those faces must have taken forever!'
